DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to consult us about today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 住まいについて相談したいです。家族が書いてくれたメモがありますが、私の希望も自分でお話ししたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族のメモに加えて本人の希望を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like advice about housing. I have a note my family wrote for me, but I'd also like to explain my own wishes myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: State your own wishes in addition to your family's note. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: メモには、どのような内容がありますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家族は広い部屋へ移りたいと書いています。私は、広さより通勤に掛かる時間を短くしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 広さと通勤時間の優先順位の違いを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: My family wrote that they want to move to a larger room. For me, shortening my commute is more important than the size.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the difference in priorities between space and commuting time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お二人の希望に違いがあるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: So the two of you have different wishes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。家族の意見を消すのではなく、家族は広さ、私は通勤時間を重視していると分けて伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二人の意見を残して分けて伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Rather than removing my family's opinion, I'll explain them separately: my family values space, while I prioritize commuting time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Keep both people's opinions and convey them separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今のお住まいで、お客様が困っている点は何でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: What are you personally having difficulty with in your current home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 職場まで一時間半掛かります。すぐに引っ越すと決めたわけではありませんが、住まいを選ぶ時に相談できる先を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現在の困り事と相談目的を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: It takes an hour and a half to get to work. I haven't decided to move right away, but I'd like to know where I can seek advice when choosing housing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain your current difficulty and the purpose of the consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 相談先の案内を確認します。メモは担当へ見せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll check the advisory services. Would you like to show the note to the person in charge?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 見せます。家族の筆跡のメモを私の決定と扱わず、私の希望は今お話しした内容として伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家族のメモと本人の決定を区別して引継ぎを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. Please don't treat the note in my family's handwriting as my decision; convey my own wishes as what I've just explained.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for a handover distinguishing your family's note from your own decision. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お二人の希望と、ご本人の相談内容を担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll convey both people's wishes and the substance of your own consultation to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 次のご案内で、何かご確認はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you would like to check about the next instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 腕を出しやすくして待つよう言われました。厚い上着の袖がまくれないので、上着を脱いで持っていてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 厚い袖がまくれず上着を脱ぐか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was told to wait with my arm easy to expose. The sleeve of my thick jacket won't roll up, so may I take it off and hold it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check whether to remove your jacket because its thick sleeve won't roll up. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 上着の下には、袖を上げられる服を着ていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are you wearing something underneath whose sleeves can be raised?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、薄い長袖です。こちらなら腕を出せます。上着を無理に引っ張って着たままにするより、脱いでまとめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 内側の服と準備方法を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, a thin long-sleeved top. I can expose my arm in that. Rather than pulling the jacket sleeve hard and keeping it on, I'll take it off and fold it together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the clothing underneath and how you'll prepare. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お荷物を置きっぱなしにせず、ご自身でお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please keep your belongings with you rather than leaving them unattended.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。上着をかばんの上に畳みます。中の服はそのまま着て、どのくらい腕を出すかは担当の案内を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 上着をまとめ腕を出す範囲を担当へ聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I understand. I'll fold the jacket on top of my bag. I'll keep the clothing underneath on and follow the staff's instructions about how much of my arm to expose.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Gather your jacket and ask the person in charge how much of your arm to expose. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: いま袖をきつく巻いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Is your sleeve rolled up tightly right now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 少しきついので、一度下ろしました。呼ばれるまで巻き上げたままにせず、担当に言われた時に上げます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: きつい袖を下ろし準備の時機を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: It was a little tight, so I lowered it. I won't keep it rolled up until I'm called; I'll raise it when the person in charge tells me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you've lowered the tight sleeve and explain when you'll prepare. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お名前を呼びますので、上着もお持ちになってお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll call your name. Please bring your jacket as you proceed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。上着をまとめました。荷物を全部持ち、準備の範囲を自分で決めず担当の案内に合わせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 上着と荷物を持ち案内に合わせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I've gathered my jacket. I'll carry all my belongings and follow the person in charge's guidance rather than decide the extent of preparation myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Bring your jacket and belongings and follow the guidance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらへお進みください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: なくした鍵について、特徴を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: I'll ask about the features of the keys you lost.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 鍵が二本で、小さい札を付けています。ただ、札に書いた電話番号は前の番号です。そこへ連絡しても今の私にはつながりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 紛失鍵の札の電話が古いと知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: There are two keys with a small tag attached. But the phone number on the tag is my old one. Calling it won't reach me now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that the phone number on the lost keys' tag is outdated. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 札の色や文字は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know the tag's color and writing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 黄色で、名前は名字だけです。電話番号も書いてありますが、番号を変えた時に札を書き直し忘れました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 札の外観と更新忘れを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's yellow, and only my surname is written as the name. There's also a phone number, but I forgot to rewrite the tag when I changed numbers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the tag's appearance and forgetting to update it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現在の連絡先は別にお伝えいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Could you provide your current contact details separately?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。今の番号はこちらです。札の特徴として古い番号を説明しますが、相談の連絡先は今の方でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現在の連絡先を別に提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. This is my current number. I'll describe the old number as a feature of the tag, but please use my current one to contact me about this consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Provide your current contact details separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかに、鍵を見分ける特徴はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Are there other features that help distinguish the keys?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一本には青い印があります。住所を示す札は付けていません。二本の鍵と黄色い札の組合せで説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 鍵と札の組合せの特徴を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: One has a blue mark. There's no tag showing my address. I'll describe them as a combination of two keys and a yellow tag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Describe the combination of the keys and tag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 最後に使った場所も伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll also ask where you last used them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今朝、家を出る時に使いました。古い番号の札があることと、今の連絡先を別に記録して、紛失の経緯をお話しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 最後の使用と二つの番号の役割を整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I used them when leaving home this morning. Please record the tag with the old number separately from my current contact details, and I'll explain how they went missing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain the last use and clarify the different roles of the two numbers. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。特徴と現在の連絡先を分けて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll check the identifying features and current contact details separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物の宛名を確認しますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: I'll check the address label on your package.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 箱が細く、宛名の紙が角へ回ってしまいました。住所が折れて読みにくいので、差し出す前に直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 宛名が箱の角で読みにくいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: The box is narrow, and the address paper wraps around a corner. The address is folded and hard to read, so I'd like to fix it before sending it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the address is hard to read around the box's corner. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この平らな面なら、紙の向きを変えて置けそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: On this flat surface, it looks like you could fit the paper by changing its orientation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 縦向きに置くのですね。住所の途中で角をまたがず、この面へ収めます。文字を小さく書きつぶすより、紙の向きを変えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 紙の向きを変え平面へ収める方法を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I should place it vertically. I'll keep the address on this surface without crossing a corner midway. Rather than cramming in tiny writing, I'll change the paper's orientation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain how to change the paper's orientation to fit it on a flat surface. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 古い宛名の紙は外せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Can you remove the old address paper?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、まだ仮に留めただけです。外して一枚だけ付け直します。二つの宛名が残らないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 古い紙を外し宛名一枚へ直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, it's only temporarily attached. I'll remove it and reattach just one sheet so two addresses aren't left on the box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Remove the old paper and leave just one address label. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 箱を閉じるテープに重なる部分はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Does any part overlap with the tape used to close the box?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この端が重なりそうです。紙を少し中央へ寄せて、住所と箱の閉じ目を別にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 閉じ目と宛名が重ならないよう調整する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: This edge looks like it might. I'll move the paper slightly toward the middle so the address and the box's closing seam are separate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Adjust the address so it doesn't overlap the closing seam. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご準備ができましたら、こちらへお出しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please bring it here when you're ready.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 読める向きで平らな面に貼り直しました。旧い紙は外し、閉じ目も留めました。この箱の大きさで送れる方法を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 貼り直しを確認して発送方法を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've reattached it on the flat surface in a readable orientation. I removed the old paper and secured the closing seam too. I'd like advice on a shipping method for this box size.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the label has been reattached and ask about shipping. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。箱の寸法と重さを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll check the box's dimensions and weight.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この欄をご覧いただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Could you look at this field?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: すみません、今まで裏面を見ていました。説明された欄がないと思っていたので、表へ戻して確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 裏面を見ていたと伝え表を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Sorry, I've been looking at the back. I thought the field you described wasn't there, so I'd like to turn back to the front and check.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you were looking at the back and check the front. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 表の上にある題名は見えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you see the title at the top of the front?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、見えます。裏は注意事項でした。注意の段落を申込欄だと思って探していました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 裏の注意と表の申込欄を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, I can. The back had the precautions. I was searching the precautions paragraph thinking it was the application section.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the precautions on the back from the application fields on the front. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 表の二つ目の欄が、いまご説明した箇所です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The second field on the front is the part I just explained.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ここですね。先ほどの説明をこの欄と合わせて、もう一度聞かせてください。違う面を見ていたので、内容を理解できていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 正しい欄で説明の聞き直しを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here, right? Please explain it again while matching the explanation to this field. I was looking at the other side, so I haven't understood the content.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to hear the explanation again with the correct field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この欄には、ご本人の連絡先を記入します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: In this field, enter your own contact details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。記入するのは表の連絡先欄ですね。裏の注意事項も後で読みますが、そこへ番号は書きません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 連絡先の記入位置を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I understand. So I write in the contact field on the front. I'll read the precautions on the back later too, but I won't write my number there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm where to enter your contact details. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 記入前に、ほかにご確認はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Is there anything else you'd like to check before writing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今はありません。表の欄を確認できたので自分の連絡先を書きます。説明中は同じ面を見ているか先に確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同じ面を確認して記入へ進む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Not now. I've located the front field, so I'll write my own contact details. During explanations, I'll first check we're looking at the same side.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the same side and proceed to fill it in. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。記入後にこちらで確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll check it here after you've filled it in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 値札についてご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about the price tags?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。同じ果物なのに値段が違います。こちらは一個、こちらは一袋と書いてあるので、袋の個数も見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 値札の一個と一袋を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It's the same fruit, but the prices differ. This says per piece and that says per bag, so I'd like to check the number in the bag too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check the “per piece” and “per bag” price labels. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この袋には三個入っています。ばらの方は一個の値札です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This bag contains three. The loose fruit's price tag is for one piece.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 三個入りですね。一袋の値段を一個の値段と思って、高いと決めていました。必要な個数で比べ直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 袋の個数と価格の読み違いを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Three in a bag, then. I'd assumed the bag's price was for one piece and decided it was expensive. I'll compare again based on how many I need.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the bag quantity and your mistake reading the price. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今日は何個必要でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: How many do you need today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一個だけです。三個を分ける予定はないので、単位の値段だけでなく食べる量も考え、ばらを選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 必要数からばら売りを選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Only one. I have no plans to divide up three, so I'll consider how much we'll eat, not just the unit price, and choose a loose piece.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose loose fruit based on the quantity needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ばらの方は、こちらの売場からお取りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please take the loose fruit from this section.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。袋から一個だけ取るのではなく、ばらの売場の品を一個取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 適切な売場から一個を取る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Rather than take one out of a bag, I'll take one item from the loose-fruit section.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Take one item from the appropriate section. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お選びになった数は一個でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: So you've selected one piece, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、一個です。値札の単位と実際に取った品を確認しました。三個袋の方はそのままにして、こちらを会計へ持っていきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 単位と実際の購入数を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, one. I've checked the price tag's unit and the actual item I took. I'll leave the three-piece bag as it is and take this to checkout.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the unit and actual purchase quantity. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ありがとうございます。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人とこのベンチに座っています。手紙を書く時に肘が当たるので、少し位置を変えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 手紙を書く肘のスペースを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm sitting on this bench with a friend. Our elbows bump when I write a letter, so I'd like to adjust our positions a little.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about elbow space for writing a letter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お二人の荷物も座面にありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Both of your bags are on the seat as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。まず自分のかばんを足元へ下ろします。友人のかばんを勝手に動かすのではなく、空けられるか聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分の荷物を動かし友人へ相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. First I'll put my own bag down at my feet. Rather than move my friend's bag without asking, I'll ask whether they can free up some space.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Move your own belongings and consult your friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ほかの方が座れる場所も残してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please leave room for other people to sit too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。紙を横へ何枚も並べず、一枚だけ画板の上へ置きます。友人にも少し寄ってもらえるか相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 紙を広げず他の利用者の席を残す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I understand. I won't spread several sheets sideways; I'll put just one on my drawing board. I'll also ask my friend whether they can move over a little.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Avoid spreading papers out and leave seats for other users. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 友人の方も何か書く予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Is your friend planning to write something too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人は本を読みたいそうです。私が書く間ずっと立ってもらうより、二人で座れる位置を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人の読書もできる位置を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: My friend wants to read. Rather than make them stand the whole time I'm writing, we'll decide positions where we can both sit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide positions where your friend can also read. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 書き終わった後は、荷物を戻しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Will you put your belongings back after you've finished writing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: かばんは帰るまで足元で持ちます。手紙を封筒へしまい、使った消しゴムや紙が座面に残っていないか確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 手紙と道具を片付け座面を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll keep my bag at my feet until we leave. I'll put the letter in an envelope and check that no eraser or paper I used remains on the seat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Put away the letter and tools and check the seat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。お二人で譲り合ってご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08221-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please use the bench considerately together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with anything?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 迎えに来る人へ、列車の名前を駅の名前のように送ってしまいました。降りる駅を確認して訂正したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 列車名を駅名として送った誤りを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I sent the person picking me up the train's name as though it were a station name. I'd like to check the station where I'll get off and correct it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about mistakenly sending a train name as a station name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 乗る予定の案内をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the information for the train you plan to take?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。上の太い文字を駅名だと思いましたが、列車名でした。下にある到着駅を相手へ伝え直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 案内の列車名と到着駅の欄を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here it is. I thought the bold writing at the top was the station name, but it was the train name. I'll send the arrival station below to them again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the train name from the arrival station field in the information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この欄が到着駅です。日付と到着予定も併せてご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: This field is the arrival station. Please check the date and expected arrival as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。駅名と今日の到着予定を送り、先ほどの文字は列車名だったと説明します。相手がどこで待つかも聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 正しい駅名と日付時刻を連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I'll send the station name and today's expected arrival, and explain that the earlier text was the train's name. I'll also ask where they will wait.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Contact them with the correct station name, date, and time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今、お相手から返事はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you received a reply from them now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 確認できたそうです。相手は駅名を検索しても見付からず困っていました。正しい駅の出口を決めてから迎えに出るそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 相手の確認と迎えの準備状況を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: They say they've confirmed it. They were having trouble because searching for the station name found nothing. They say they'll choose an exit at the correct station before leaving to pick me up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report their confirmation and pickup preparations. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 出口の相談は、到着駅の案内で確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can check exit information in the guidance for the arrival station.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。今は駅名と時刻を訂正し、出口は相手の返事を待ちます。列車名も別の情報として残しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 駅情報の訂正と出口の未確定を整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand. For now I've corrected the station name and time, and I'll wait for their reply about the exit. I'll also keep the train name as separate information.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Clarify the station correction and that the exit is still undecided. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。乗車の案内をご確認のうえお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please check your boarding information before proceeding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どのようなご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to consult us about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この説明会へ参加したいです。三日分の日付がありますが、全部には行けません。一日だけ参加できるか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 三日開催の説明会へ一日参加できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to attend this information session. Three dates are listed, but I can't attend all of them. I'd like to check whether I can attend just one day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can attend one day of a three-day information session. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご希望の日はどちらですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二日目です。仕事の休みがその日だけなので、一日ずつ選べるのか、続けて受ける内容なのか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 希望日と連続参加の条件を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The second day. That's my only day off work, so I'd like to know whether you can choose individual days or whether the content must be taken consecutively.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm your preferred day and the conditions for consecutive attendance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 日ごとの内容と申込条件を担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check each day's content and the application conditions with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。空いている日だけ先に丸を付けず、二日目だけでも内容が分かるか聞いてから申し込みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 申込前に一日参加の内容を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. Rather than circle my free day first, I'd like to ask whether the second day alone will make sense before applying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the content for one-day attendance before applying. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 説明会で知りたいことは何でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: What would you like to learn at the session?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 子どもの生活に関する相談先です。二日目が別のテーマなら、目的に合う資料だけ受け取れるかも相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 知りたいテーマと資料の代替を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Where to seek advice about my child's daily life. If the second day covers another topic, I'd also like to ask whether I can just receive materials suited to my purpose.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State the topic you want to know and materials as an alternative. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へ、その目的も伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll convey that purpose to the person in charge too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。一日だけの参加希望と知りたいテーマを伝え、参加できなければ資料の案内を聞きます。全部参加すると書いては出しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 参加希望と代替方法を整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll state that I wish to attend one day and the topic I want to know about, and if I can't attend, I'll ask about the materials. I won't submit a form saying I'll attend all days.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Clarify your attendance wishes and alternative arrangements. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。内容と参加方法を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll check the content and how to participate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 受付でお伝えになりたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you'd like to tell reception?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日の状態を撮った写真を診察で見せたいです。ただ、暗くて見えにくいので、写真だけで全部伝わるとは思っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 暗い経過写真を診察で示したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to show a photo of yesterday's condition during the consultation. But it's dark and hard to see, so I don't assume the photo alone will convey everything.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to show a dark photo of the condition's progress at the consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 写真はご自身の状態を撮った物ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is the photo of your own condition?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。昨日の夜、腕の一部分を撮りました。全体を撮った物ではなく、今の写真でもありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 撮影した日時と身体の範囲を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I took a photo of part of my arm last night. It doesn't show the whole arm, and it isn't a current photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain when the photo was taken and the body area shown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 診察で、撮った時刻と場所も担当へ説明してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: During the consultation, explain the time and area photographed to the person in charge too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。腕のどの部分か自分で示します。暗い部分を明るく加工して実際の色が変わるより、元の写真を見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 元画像を示し撮影箇所を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I understand. I'll point out which part of my arm it is myself. Rather than brighten the dark area and alter its actual color, I'll show the original photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the original image and explain the photographed area. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 写真のほかに経過を書いた物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have anything written about the progression besides the photo?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 昨日気付いた時刻をメモしました。写真に写らない違和感もあったので、それは言葉で話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 写真外の感じと時刻メモを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I noted the time I noticed it yesterday. There was also an uncomfortable sensation that doesn't show in a photo, so I'll describe that in words.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain the sensations outside the photo and your note of the time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご自身で担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell the person in charge yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。昨日の写真の範囲と暗さ、メモの時刻、写らない感じを分けて説明します。今の状態も診察で見てもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 画像と経過と現在の状態を分けて話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll explain separately the range and darkness of yesterday's photo, the time in my note, and the sensation that doesn't show. I'll also have my current condition examined during the consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Discuss the image, progression, and current condition separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。写真とメモをお手元に置いてお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08222-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please wait with the photo and note at hand.
